Title: Azure Scheduler updates HTTP/HTTPS job timeout

Body.Content:
Based on customer requests, we updated the HTTP/HTTPS job timeout in Azure Scheduler from 30 seconds to 60 seconds. This change applies to existing and new jobs.

To learn more about limits and defaults in Scheduler, visit the Quotas and limits page.
